newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BANKS, GAS ADVANCE, MARKET REMAINS MIXED.
newsitem.headline: BANKS, GAS ADVANCE, MARKET REMAINS MIXED.

text.p: The bourse was mixed on Tuesday although the banks and Lithuanian Gas advanced, dealers said.
Some dealers said the market was quiet for now but that prices may rise later.
"The bearish tendency on the bourse continues as, judging by turnover, there are few foreign investors on the market," Grazhina Bachiuliene of Vilfima brokerage told Reuters.
"We expect the number of foreign investors to increase after the international conference on investment opportunities in Lithuania next week in Vilnius," she added.
Hermis Bank gained to 180 litas from 174 litas and Vilniaus Bank was up by 1.81 percent to 225 litas.
Lithuanian Gas, which reported on Monday its first quarter profit of 19 million litas, on Monday rose to 2.0 litas from 1.9 litas and was regaining its former strength, dealers said.
Kalnapilis brewery saw its shares dip by 47.76 percent to 3.5 litas after it registered its share capital boost to 25.4 million litas.
"It is normal as the company tripled its share capital from reserves and the shares fell only by half," Bachiuliene said.
Klaipeda Stevedoring continued to slide down and was traded 10 percent lower at 11.16 litas.
Its price drop was influenced by the decision to double its share capital from reserves, dealers said.
Birzai Dairy remained unchanged at 10.25 litas.
